customDescription_1: Wish you could combine two pieces? Inspired by a piece that is no longer available? You looked at all ready to ship items and can't find the perfect one? You're yearning to add Petrichor's special touch of magic to your life?
customDescription_2: Don't despair; Petrichor loves to collaborate to create art specifically for their patrons! You'll be able to choose from many precious stones, ethically sourced bones and other focal pieces that are waiting to be brought to life. They can be framed with copper or sterling silver wire.
customDescription_3: {#mailto to=|kate@petrichordreams.com| subject=|Custom piece|}Contact Petrichor{/mailto} to start the discussion. Feel free to include inspirations of past work, style, size, and gemstone or colour.
ritualsSubheading: Let Petrichor weave magic for you
ritualsDescription_1: Some pieces of art are born out of stories, infused with specific intentions, and carry that power inside them.
ritualsDescription_2: Weaving Rituals are for those who want more than ordinary jewelry. During this very special process, Petrichor will invite you into the creative process. Weaving your unique journey and aspirations with their craft, they will create a talisman that is tied to you. As a fulltime traveler, Petrichor frequently visits lands of great strength: from majestic fjords to enchanted meadows, glistening streams, dark forests and imposing mountains. These places of power are the perfect settings in which to weave the masterpiece that will accompany you through your own adventures.
ritualsDescription_3: This experience includes a one hour videocall to discuss the ritual, your personalized talisman and a polaroid of the altar created for the weaving ritual.
ritualsContact: {#mailto to=|kate@petrichordreams.com| subject=|Weaving Ritual|}Contact Petrichor{/mailto} to start planning your ritual.
